title: CMIS Formal Verification Milestone 1
description: A reproducible, provenance-controlled verification register for pinned public Lean theorem formalizations, including statement comparison, Lean-kernel replay, axiom auditing, immutable receipts, and family-level scope classification. Milestone 1 records 42 formally passed theorem declarations, 18 validated mathematical families, and nine completed bounded non-validation reviews.
notes: CMIS does not claim authorship of externally sourced mathematical theorems. The project contributes independent reproduction, statement checking, kernel replay, axiom auditing, receipt integrity, scope classification, and reproducibility.
